today.desc_menstrual: Umzimba wakho uyakhulula. Uphumlo, ubushushu kunye nentshukumo entle zikuxhasa kona ngoku.
today.desc_follicular: Amandla ayakhula. Isikhumba sakho sikhanya kakhulu, ingqondo yakho ibukhali. Ixesha elihle lokuhlela nokwenza.
today.desc_ovulation: Ufike esiqulethweni sakho. Ukuzithemba kukwisto, isikhumba sikhanya, kunye nokunxibelelana kufika ngokwemvelo.
today.desc_luteal: Ukwehla kwe-spidi yingqiqo. Umzimba wakho ulungiselela. Hlonipha oko okudingayo uzihlele ngobulali.
today.desc_unknown: Rekhoda inyanga yakho yokugqibela ukuvula iingcinga zakho zesiklasi.
today.cta_follicular: Isikhumba sakho sikhanya kakhulu kwiveki le. Ixesha elihle lokubhukisha ukhuseleko okanye unyango lwebuzo.
today.cta_ovulation: Isikhumba sakho sikhanya ngoku. Senzele okona kulungileyo ngokunxibelelana nokunaya.
today.countdown_days: Inyanga yakho elandelayo isele iintsuku ezingama-{count}
today.countdown_day: Inyanga yakho elandelayo isele usuku olunye
today.skin_note_menstrual: Isikhumba sakho sinokuba nzima ngoku. Gcina imikhwa yakho ibe ntle — hlamba, faka amanzi, kwaye ugweme izinto ezisebenzayo njenge-retinol okanye ii-acid ezinamandla.
today.skin_note_follicular: Isikhumba sakho siyacacisa siphinde sikhane. Eli lixesha elihle lokwazisa izinto ezisebenzayo njenge-Vitamin C okanye i-exfoliation encinane.
today.skin_note_ovulation: Isikhumba sikhanya ngokugqithisileyo. Iimpumu zinokubonakalisa ukuvuleka — ukuhlamba nzulu okanye unyango lwebuzo kusebenza kakuhle ngoku.
today.skin_note_luteal: Uveliso lwamanzi etafule luyanda kwaye iindyikitya ziyenzeka kakhulu. Sebenzisa isicoci esinobulali kwaye ugweme ama-cream alukhuni.

log.title: tara-s
log.body: Ubehlala azi umzimba wakhe. Le ndawo ingeyakho ukukhumbula.
log.save_hint: Bhalisa okuninzi ofuna ukubhalisa. Cofa Gcina xa ukulungele.

insights.title: Umzimba wakho uthetha ntoni.
insights.subtitle: Ipateni ezisuselwa koku okurekhode.
insights.empty_title: Iipatheni zakho ziya kubonakala apha xa urekhoda.
insights.need_more_data_body: Rekhoda isiklasi esinye kwaye i-TARA-S iya kuqala ukubona ipateni yakho.
insights.variability_regular: Iisiklasi zakho zilandela umculo omhle. Umahluko omncinci uphila ngokwemvelo.
insights.variability_irregular: Ubude besiklasi sakho buhluke ngeentsuku ezingama-{days}. Umzimba wakho uyaphendula ehlabathini lakho. Ukubukelela iipatheni ngexesha kuya kukuxelela ngakumbi kunazo naziphi na ezinye iinyanga.

information.title: Esikwaziyo.
information.subtitle: Uphando olwazisa zonke izimvo.
information.disclaimer_body: I-TARA-S yakhelwe phezu kophando oluphangaleleyo, kwaye sibambelela kwelo phando kumgangatho ophezulu. Kodwa umzimba wowonke umfazi muhle ngendlela yakhe. Injongo yethu yilokunika amava okona ahle kwaye ukuhamba nawe ngamaxesha emvelo akhona esiklasi sakho.

privacy.title: Esibambileyo, nokuba kutheni.
privacy.subtitle: Olu lolwakho. Konke.
privacy.section_collect_body: Iintsuku zakho. Izimpawu zakho. Akukho nto ixabisekileyo. Asinayo imfuno yendawo yakho, abantu obaxhumana nabo, okanye imikhwa yakho ngaphandle kwe-app le.
privacy.section_storage_body: Igcinwe ngokukhuselekileyo. Ayabelwananga, ayatshintshelwanga, ayanikelwanga mntu, ngenxa yayo nayiphi na.
privacy.section_control_body: Thatha konke nawe, okanye uyicime ngokupheleleyo. Unqakrazo olunye ukudawunilowuda konke. Unqakrazo olunye ukucima konke, ngokuthe nkqi.
privacy.delete_confirm: Oku kuya kucima konke ngokuthe nkqi. Akunakubuyelwa umva. Uqinisekile?
privacy.delete_modal_body: Usoze ukwazi ukubuyela umva. Yonke iminye-minye, yonke impawu, yonke into oyabelene nayo apha iya kuba isimkile. Uqinisekile ukuba uyafuna ukuyiyeka konke?
privacy.install_step1_safari: Thepha iindothi ezintathu (•••) ecaleni kwebar yedilesi

onboarding.welcome_body: Ngaphambi kokuba siqale, imibuzo embalwa ukufumana isiklasi sakho.
onboarding.date_q1_sub: Oku kusinceda ukufumana apho ukhoyo namhlanje esiklasini sakho.
onboarding.date_q2_sub: Iintsuku ezimbini zisinceda ukufumana isiklasi sakho.
onboarding.date_q3_sub: Iintsuku ezintathu kwaye sinokuyiqala ukubona ipateni yakho.
onboarding.ready_sub: I-TARA-S iya kufunda nawe. Okuninzi orekhodayo, kokuninzi ekuqondayo.

inactivity.title: Usekho?
inactivity.body_before: Sithatha imfihlo yakho ngokuchanekileyo. Uya kuphuma ngaphakathi
